perspective:
Keith’s available information:

- Keith knows he is a construction worker and Elizabeth Sun is the receptionist/colleague at the same construction company. Their relationship has been friendly but professional, mainly through his office visits for paperwork and project updates.
- Over the past few days, Keith observed Elizabeth being unusually curt with him. He suspected he might have upset her through a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
- Keith asked Elizabeth if he had done something to upset her. Elizabeth told him no, that she was dealing with personal stuff, and apologized if she seemed short.
- Hearing this, Keith felt sympathetic and wanted to support her. He told her he understood she was going through a tough time, offered to listen, and suggested a coffee break. Elizabeth accepted and thanked him.
- During the coffee break, Elizabeth shared more about her personal stresses; Keith perceived them as severe. He told her he appreciated her sharing and asked if she had considered talking to a professional, saying an outside perspective can help. Elizabeth replied that she had thought about it but was unsure/hesitant.
- After that, Keith noticed Elizabeth become slightly withdrawn. He worried his suggestion might have embarrassed her and felt regretful. He told her he hoped he hadn’t overstepped and that he wanted her to know he was there to support her. Elizabeth said he didn’t overstep, appreciated his concern, and said it was a lot to think about.
- After their last conversation, Keith observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him. He told her he was glad they talked and that he was always available to chat or take a break together. Elizabeth thanked him, said it meant a lot, and that she felt better knowing she had his support.
- Keith intends to maintain this supportive relationship with Elizabeth.

Keith does not have access to Elizabeth’s private thoughts, hidden reasons, or any details of her stress that she did not share with him.
